correctness.rationale: Exact all-integer proof: the four possible intersection sizes in the part of size three establish the cut-cone dual bound, and a nonnegative two-orbit cut combination attains it. Standalone Fraction checker completed 184728 exact assertions through n=300, including direct cut enumeration through n=9; those tests supplement the proof.

value.rationale: A natural exact all-n classification for fixed unit-edge K_{3,n} rather than isolated small graphs: sharp rational mod-three staircase, strict one-dimensional family limit 5/3, explicit optimal cuts, and rigidity of every optimal distance profile.
